reviews.comment: I really like the way Dr. Mishra teaches by blending concepts with practical examples. The lecture notes are very useful and make it easy to take notes. I also love the quizzes—they warm me up before class and help me revisit the previous lecture. Overall, it's a great class!
Professor Mishra explains difficult topics clearly, and the in-class exercises really help reinforce the concepts. I highly recommend him
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: He seems to know a lot about the subject but just isn't very good at teaching it. His slides and tests were all over the place as far as formatting, so hard to follow. He's also got a really thick accent. He does lots of examples in class and is usually available to help. Pop quizzes once a week for attendance, but not very hard if you go to class.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. M is a great professor. He genuinely cares about his students. Sometimes he can be funny.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Mishra is a knowledgeable and approachable instructor with expertise in water resources. I appreciate his quizzes and the way he integrates examples with concepts, making the material easier to understand. Attending his classes is valuable, and he is attentive enough to notice when students miss a session.
